name: history-motion
js: const sec = document.querySelector('#history'); const st = () => [sec.className, sec.querySelector('.hs-verdict').textContent.slice(0, 50), [...sec.querySelectorAll('.hs-num-v')].map(d => d.textContent).join('/'), sec.querySelectorAll('.hs-mark.is-stamped').length, sec.querySelectorAll('.hs-thread.is-on').length, sec.querySelector('.hs-pay').disabled, sec.querySelectorAll('.hs-n')[0].textContent].join(' | '); const out = [st()]; sec.querySelector('.hs-pay').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 3500)); out.push(st(), sec.querySelector('.hs-slip').className + ' ' + !!sec.querySelector('.hs-qr svg')); sec.querySelector('.hs-hide').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500)); out.push(st(), sec.querySelectorAll('.hs-thread.is-cut').length); sec.querySelector('.hs-reset').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800)); out.push(st()); return out;

name: finale-motion
js: const sec = document.querySelector('#on-testnet'); const out = [sec.className]; sec.querySelectorAll('.fn-lens-opt')[1].click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500)); out.push(sec.className, [...sec.querySelector('.fn-env').children].map(c => c.getAttribute('class') || 'flapAt').join(','), sec.querySelector('.fn-flap').style.transform); sec.querySelectorAll('.fn-lens-opt')[0].click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500)); out.push(sec.className, sec.querySelector('.fn-flap').style.transform); return out;
